svg.title: Four waveforms and the spectra of their samples
svg.desc: Four waveforms, square(40, 0.3), gaussian_square(40, 0.3, 4, 20), gaussian(40, 0.3, 10) and cosine(40, 0.3), each 20 ns long with amplitude 0.3, above the spectrum of their samples from -60 to 0 dB within 500 MHz of the tone. A shaded band marks where 99% of each spectrum's energy up to half the clock lies: square ±427 MHz, gaussian_square ±105 MHz, gaussian ±59 MHz, cosine ±70 MHz. Outside its band the gaussian's spectrum still peaks at -41 dB between 400 and 500 MHz, and the cosine's is below -60 dB from 332 MHz on.
